conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones, mixamorig: names), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.world: the bowler runs toward the rig's forward direction (at the batter). Positions: 'behind_crease'/'forward_of_crease' along the pitch from the bowler's popping crease, 'left' = the bowler's left of the middle-stump line, 'up' = height
conventions.start: each clip starts standing at the top of the mark (start_position_m) and contains the whole run-up, bound, back-foot contact, front-foot contact, release, follow-through and deceleration
conventions.ball: attach the ball to the bowling hand (RightHand, or LeftHand for left-arm clips) until release_frame; release_point_m is where it leaves the hand
conventions.lateral_convention: in deliveries: positive lateral_m = INTO a right-handed batter (toward his pads), negative = AWAY (toward the slips)
conventions.around_the_wicket: release variants are over the wicket; for a variant from around the wicket play the matching *_around_* stock clip with that variant's release physics
conventions.lengths_and_lines: see lengths_pitching_m_from_batters_stumps / lines_m_from_middle_stump; play the bouncer clip for bouncer/short lengths and the yorker clip for yorker/full-toss lengths (length_to_release_variant)
